original_ai_output.title_zh: 十字河州立大学ASUU因欠薪恢复罢工
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚十字河州立大学学术人员工会（ASUU）因两个月工资未发及州政府未落实协议，恢复无限期罢工。据报州长此前给予90天解决窗口，该期限已过。工会称罢工将持续至2025年协议得到执行、成员福利问题得到解决。

location.raw_text: Prefab Hall of the university’s Calabar main campus

key_facts.fact: 十字河州立大学ASUU因欠薪恢复无限期罢工
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Cross River varsity ASUU resumes strike over salary arrears

key_facts.fact: 罢工原因为两个月工资未发及州政府未落实协议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: resumed its indefinite strike over the non-payment of two months’ salaries and the failure of the state government to implement agreements reached with the union

key_facts.fact: 据报州长此前给予的90天解决窗口已到期
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: followed the expiration of a 90-day window reportedly granted by Governor Bassey Otu in July

key_facts.fact: 决定在卡拉巴尔主校区Prefab Hall紧急会议上作出
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: emergency congress held on Monday at the Prefab Hall of the university’s Calabar main campus

uncertainties: 州长给予90天窗口一事为据报，尚未获独立确认
目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
